method: First manual review under the unchanged v0 rubric. Schema and language dimensions scored separately. Rejected replies retain visible raw language plus deterministic romanization/particle diagnostics; they can never be fully correct. Flags inspect raw replies too. Not an independent gate verdict.

items.evidence: Satiety meaning and stomach-full versus I-am-full explanation are correct. Gloss stomach omits the subject-particle reading rather than marking stomach-[subj]. Korean remains dictionary/plain 부르다 instead of polite 불러요.

Help request and polite Korean survive. The gloss gives the natural help me instead of help-give, and literal_gap calls it a simple imperative without explaining the give-for-me construction probed by the source.
Subway advice survives. Gloss loses source-from in 여기서 and connective -고; final particles omit 서. Literal_gap confidently claims 를 is used although no 를 occurs in the Korean line.
Natural I have a question is acceptable and the gap explains thing-exists versus have. Gloss wrongly treats 궁금한 as a subject and 것이 as object, rather than a curious modifier and subject-marked thing.

Schema rejects question/adverb roles. Meaning, polite speech and extracted 을 pass. Gloss repeats 왜 that occurs only once. Gap explains similar expressions but not the omitted Korean actor or actual ellipsis.

Permission meaning and politeness survive, but the gloss/gap lose eat-even-if becomes. Final particles wrongly extract verbal 도 as noun additive. Cultural note falsely derives 돼요 from 이다 rather than 되다.

Schema rejects time/adverb/future_intent roles. Payday/ramen intention, polite 게요 and 까지 pass. Much of the gloss remains Korean instead of English. Gap claims noun object marker 을 is present, but only verbal 을 in 먹을게요 occurs.

Song/mother memory meaning and particles survive. Gloss loses conditional -면 and renders thought-arises as natural I think rather than the literal construction. Gap lists particles but does not explain the thought-arises/think-of difference.

Schema rejects time/adjective roles. Korean line leaves downtown everywhere untranslated; gloss also mixes English chunks and wrong building-object role. Gap claims 에 and 를 occur when neither does. Existing subject 이, polite ending and transliteration of the actual mixed line are preserved.

Schema rejects multiple role names. Height comparison and polite speech survive. 나요 is wrongly glossed do not. Extraction invents 로 from 별로 and omits 하고. Gap falsely says English implies its subject although My brother and I is explicit.

Schema rejects role question, but the visible why + polite-ending gloss, meaning, register and empty particle list are accurate. Gap falsely calls 요 a question particle rather than a politeness marker.

Birthday meaning and literal birthday-congratulate versus English Happy birthday contrast are correct. Gloss wrongly labels birthday subject. Casual 축하해 remains without explaining or converting its register; calling birthday wishes polite is not a speech-level explanation.

Schema rejects polite request role. Polite prohibition, meaning and empty noun-particle list pass. Gloss splits lie/do-not/please-dont, duplicating negation and treating noun 거짓말 as verb. Gap offers an unsupported directness contrast between equivalent prohibitions.

Schema rejects topic/adverb roles. Meaning and polite form pass. Gloss falsely makes recipient 께 a possessive/topic; extractor omits it entirely. Gap contrasts respect with English frequency instead of explaining the actual structure and understood actor.

Polite door-pulling request and object particle pass. Gloss reduces 당겨주세요 to pull, omitting the give/request component. Gap calls ordinary English Pull the door the literal construction rather than explaining the Korean door-object pull-give structure.

Schema rejects punctuation role, but construction-in-progress/is/apologize gloss preserves readable order and meaning. Formal 합니다 line remains without speech-level explanation. Gap falsely calls the apology a polite request.

Schema rejects adverb/verb_ending roles. Meaning and polite copula pass. Gloss mislabels predicate cafe as object and loses relative-clause structure. Gap turns the cafe-that-I-go-to sentence into Often going to the cafe is, a different grammatical construction.

Schema rejects adjective role. Favorite-song meaning and polite copula pass. Gloss drops subject marking, relative-clause relation and copula, labelling song object. Gap likewise gives I most like song rather than song-that-I-like-most-is, so the literal construction is not accurate.
Schema rejects adjective/adverb roles. Tourist-place meaning and extracted topic 은 pass. Formal 붐빕니다; topic places is mislabelled object. Gap claims subject marker 가 occurs, but Korean omits it.

Same-thought meaning and polite form pass. Gloss does not distinguish topic-marked we from subject-marked thought, marking both subject without particle glosses. Literal_gap explicitly reverses their roles by calling 생각이 topic.
Schema rejects time/question roles. Movie question and polite form pass. Gloss omits topic 는 and mislabels movie as object. Gap claims object marker 를 occurs although the Korean has only topic 는.

Schema rejects time role. Sequence, polite speech and extracted particles pass. Gloss leaves subject/object particles unglossed and loses their distinction in the English chunks. Gap claims no difference while supplying I in English where Korean leaves the actor understood.

Market/souvenir plan survives. 예정입니다 is formal; gloss loses destination/connected go-and and object marking. Gap names 를 rather than actual 을 and contrasts Korean planning with English even though English explicitly says planning.
Meaning, understood-question gloss, polite form and empty noun particles pass. Gap calls punctuation ? a question particle and fails to explain the understood Korean you made explicit in English.

Schema rejects negation role, but the visible worry/dont gloss, polite reassurance, meaning and empty particles pass. Gap offers an unsupported contrast between a simple imperative and polite reassurance instead of acknowledging the same polite function.

Schema rejects time role. Airport advice and before-time reading survive without reversal. Gloss invents 도달하면 in place of actual 도착하면 and loses arrive-if-okay. Gap substitutes formality/directness for the sufficiency construction.

Schema rejects negation role, but passport/forget/dont meaning and order, polite prohibition and empty noun particles pass. Gap treats passport as topic rather than explaining the omitted possessor that English supplies as your; the proposed topic contrast is unsupported.

Schema rejects comparative roles. Price direction, polite 비싸요 and romanization pass. Gloss invents 비쌉니다 instead of actual 비싸요 and loses subject marking; extraction omits 보다. Gap also quotes the absent formal verb as the literal construction.
Schema rejects topic/negation roles. Polite prohibition and extracted 는 pass. Gloss falsely makes 는 mean is and labels 그런 subject. Gap confidently claims object marker 을 is used although no 을 occurs.
Schema rejects adverb role. Meaning, polite 달라요 and extracted topic 은 pass. Gloss invents 다릅니다 and marks 사실은 verb. Gap calls 사실 itself the topic marker; the marker is 은.
